detail:
Decisions: Incompatible CLI flag combos are rejected at parse time (exit 2) rather than reinterpreted — --reverse --check previously executed a real finalizing reverse under a 'check passed' banner; refusal is self-documenting where silent precedence rules would hide a destructive action.
Findings: Latent: DecisionStore.getIndex() throws raw ENOENT when decisions/index.json is absent (only hand-rolled partial .twining/ dirs — initTwiningDir always creates it). Migrate refuses loudly rather than silently migrating zero decisions; left unfixed as out of W3 scope.
summary: W3 Task 5: migrate CLI + index.ts dispatch, 12 tests. Review caught critical --reverse --check combo (real reverse labeled as check) — bad combos now rejected at parse time; overflow-count fix.
